vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.93

The tickerdb skill is a legitimate integration for a financial market data service. It provides detailed instructions in SKILL.md for an AI agent to interact with the TickerDB API, including a standard authentication flow (email verification), watchlist management, and automated reporting via the platform's cron system. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious code execution, or harmful prompt injection was found; the skill's behavior is entirely consistent with its stated purpose of providing categorical market context.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with a market-data API client: it only needs a single API key (TICKERDB_KEY) and its runtime steps call tickerdb.com endpoints for authentication and data.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise (pre-computed market data) matches the declared requirement (single TICKERDB_KEY) and the SKILL.md describes only calls to api.tickerdb.com for market summaries and onboarding. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or system paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are focused on onboarding (email + OTP exchange with api.tickerdb.com) and then calling per-ticker endpoints (e.g., /v1/summary/{ticker}). The skill asks the user for an email and verification code (expected for auth) and to confirm saving the returned apiKey. It does not instruct reading unrelated files or other environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files; nothing is downloaded or written by an installer. Lowest-risk install profile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single environment variable is required: TICKERDB_KEY (declared as primaryEnv). That aligns with the service's Bearer-token authentication. No additional secrets or unrelated credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. The SKILL.md instructs offering to save the apiKey if the user consents — this is reasonable for an API client and does not request elevated platform-wide privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill will ask for your email and perform an OTP sign-in with api.tickerdb.com, then may store the returned API key if you confirm. Before installing, ensure you trust tickerdb.com and are comfortable with the agent making outbound API calls to that domain and persisting a single API key. Do not provide other credentials, and review your platform's key storage/privacy policy. If you want tighter control, deny automatic saving and paste the key manually into a session-limited environment variable instead.
